decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY correctly changes prize delivery to a conditional claim, but its full-array replacement reintroduces obsolete Big Block and earlier draw copy. Preserve the pre-event mechanics and change only the affected reward-delivery entries.

source_message.speaker: client

process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy the ebook NFT for $15. The mint number received becomes the buyer's referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share the mint number or referral link. Each completed referral earns an immediate, unlimited $5 commission and one ticket for the recurring $500 drawing.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every completed referral automatically adds one on-chain ticket for the active $500 drawing to the holder's NFT and dashboard. More referrals mean more chances to win.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draw
process_items.copy: One affiliate from each 100-sales block wins $500 through provably fair Chainlink VRF selection.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page, and an eligible winner collects the prize through a conditional claim button shown only when the prize is eligible to be claimed.

key_feature_items.label: Reward Delivery
key_feature_items.copy: Smart contracts issue commissions automatically, while eligible prize winners collect their prize through a conditional claim button.

key_feature_items.label: Yield Generation
key_feature_items.copy: Aave Integration enables the Small Block prize pool to accrue yield.

key_feature_items.label: Gamification
key_feature_items.copy: Badges and leaderboards keep the experience fun and competitive.

key_feature_items.label: Transparency
key_feature_items.copy: Every transaction and rule is on-chain and verifiable.

key_feature_items.label: Low Fees
key_feature_items.copy: Base provides speed with minimal transaction costs.

decisions.reason: The complete same-message MODIFY already records winner-initiated collection through a conditional claim button and removes the superseded automatic-delivery mode.
The mission-page reference to automated payouts remains valid for referral commissions and does not specify automatic prize delivery.
The landing mechanics copy describes commissions, ticket awards, drawing frequency, and winner selection but does not define how winners collect prizes.
The conditional prize-claim decision does not change the hero's text hierarchy, layout, cover integration, CTA, or visual emphasis.
Changing prize collection from direct transfer to a conditional claim does not alter ticket issuance, association, counting, reset, or display rules.
Winners still require announcement and notification through the Winners page, dashboard, and available email regardless of the subsequent claim action.
The prize-claim decision has no effect on the landing-page cover's placement, size, crop, or visibility.
The provisioned wallet still stores received prizes after collection, and its creation, custody model, access paths, and email contents remain unchanged.
Prize collection mode does not affect the mint-number referral-code identity, lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The conditional claim decision does not change SIWE authentication or dashboard access through a Transak-created wallet.
Waiting for the 100th sale to exercise the claim flow does not change the public pool values or next-draw sales counter.
